description: 150x500 budget extension for HimNet via unchanged pinned adapter and calendar-enabled STAEformer. All protocol fields match benchmark_v2_budget except models and the learning-rate grid, which is the original five-rate grid plus 0.00025 (six rates), so it brackets the original Extended30 STAEformer selection of 0.0005. Validation only at 2025; finals 2026-2028.
split: chronological 70/10/20 as stored in each dataset; training-only channel scaling
loss: mean absolute error on vehicle counts (inverse training scaling)
evaluation: test forecasts clipped at zero vehicles for every model; MAE, RMSE and WMAPE per horizon step
graph: movement-level corridor graph (experiments/movement_graph.py); graph baselines receive the same graph
